Name: Seaside Valley Expanded - SVE Compatibility
Author: risrain
Description:
After entirely too long, finally, I'm able to officially release the Seaside matching recolors for Stardew Valley Expanded's exteriors and interiors 🎉 **‼ If you previously downloaded the beta version of this I had up on the Seaside Valley download page, please delete it as there have been changes to folder structure - the beta folder is named "[CP] Seaside Valley - SVE". ‼** 

You do [b]not[/b] need to have both Seaside Valley and Seaside Interiors to use this mod - there is a separate master toggle for the exterior and interior options, so you can easily disable whichever is unneeded. While it is not required, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] will make it much easier to manage the many config options.

I cut the snow out of the overlays for all the buildings and items, so if you have an environment-matching recolor for SVE already (such as VPR's) it should show properly. If you use DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour as I do, I made a separate mod that just edits the environmental stuff of SVE so it matches (such as snow, trees, grass, so on), which can be downloaded [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45617]HERE[/url]. 

The visual mods used in the screenshots were:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿   (**Please note: In most of the screenshots, I did not use any kind of Earthy Recolour-matching mod for SVE, so that is why the snow appears vanilla. I also accidentally used my slightly modified personal copy of DNER that has green grass in the fall. [b][i]This mod does not edit the snow or the grass.[/i][/b]**)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface 2.0[/url] + [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20754]1.6 Fix[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6733]Seaside Valley[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30227]Seaside Interiors[/url]
